description: This file defines the RouteGroupInterface interface within the Slim framework, outlining methods for managing route groups, middleware addition, and retrieving route patterns.

methods.name: collectRoutes
methods.description: Method to collect all routes within the group, returning the interface for chaining.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the route group; accepts middleware as string, callable, or MiddlewareInterface.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a MiddlewareInterface instance to the route group.

methods.name: appendMiddlewareToDispatcher
methods.description: Appends the group's middleware to the provided MiddlewareDispatcher.

methods.name: getPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the pattern associated with the route group.
